tweet_summary: Gamer/streamer 'SuperSisi' shares a clip captioned 'Super North Korea 64 is a trip' — a fictional/mock-up Mario-64-themed-as-North-Korea title screen and gameplay, with copyright stamp '© 1998 SHOFAR INTERACTIVE.'
why_note_decision: Obvious satire/joke content: a clearly impossible 'official' 1998 N64 game with North Korean iconography, posted with a non-claiming caption ('is a trip') by a gamer account. Comments are split between 'AI SLOP' and 'inject this game into my veins' — community read it as joke/AI-art. The 5 noteNotNeeded raters and small sample (10 ratings total) reflect a low-stakes joke post; no reasonable viewer is going to believe an actual North Korean Mario 64 ROM exists. Even if the visuals were AI-generated (likely), there is no misleading-real-event claim to correct — the satire is the point.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The post is overt joke/satire — fake game title screen with absurd 1998 'SHOFAR INTERACTIVE' branding and DPRK iconography in a Mario 64 frame, captioned 'is a trip' by a gamer account. No reasonable viewer would treat it as a real product. FAIL any note that solemnly explains 'this is AI/fake/not a real game' on obviously-satirical content.
